Tiêu đề đề bài: Task 1.1: Replying to a Friend's Beach Holiday Invitation
Nội dung chi tiết:
You have received an email from your friend inviting you to go on a beach holiday with their family. Read part of their email below:

"My family is planning a beach holiday next month, and we would love for you to join us! The weather here is lovely and the beach is really beautiful—what do you think about coming on this trip with us? Also, for accommodation, would you like to stay in a small spare room on your own, or would you prefer sharing a room with my older sister, who is currently studying in New Zealand?"

Write an informal email responding to your friend.
title: Task 1.1: Replying to a Friend's Beach Holiday Invitation
content:
You have received an email from your friend inviting you to go on a beach holiday with their family. Read part of their email below:

Write an informal email responding to your friend.

body.answer: I'm happy to hear about your trip and I would love to join your family on this beach holiday.
body.example: Spending a few sunny days swimming and walking along the beach with your family will help me recharge my batteries.
body.frame: A. Câu dẫn cảm xúc / phản hồi mở đầu + H. Provide Opinion
body.reason: Because it is advantageous to my mental health, and it can relieve stress and reduce fatigue after my busy weeks of studying.
body.requirement: What you think about coming on the beach holiday with their family

body.answer: From my point of view, I think that staying in the small spare room on my own would be better for both of us.
body.example: I can sleep early or read a book at night, while we still spend all day together at the beach and share meals with your family.
body.reason: Opting for the small spare room offers a quiet, cozy environment where people can enjoy total personal privacy without disturbing your sister's daily routine.
body.requirement: Preference between staying in a small spare room alone or sharing with their older sister

Tiêu đề đề bài: Task 2.1: Children Using Smartphones at an Early Age
Nội dung chi tiết:
Read the following statement:

"An increasing number of children are being given smartphones from a very young age. While some people believe that early access to smartphones brings educational and communication benefits, others are concerned about its negative effects on children's health, concentration, and social skills."

Write an essay to an educated reader discussing the advantages and disadvantages of children using smartphones from an early age. Support your arguments with specific reasons and illustrative examples.
title: Task 2.1: Children Using Smartphones at an Early Age
content:
Read the following statement:

"An increasing number of children are being given smartphones from a very young age. While some people believe that early access to smartphones brings educational and communication benefits, others are concerned about its negative effects on children's health, concentration, and social skills."

Write an essay to an educated reader discussing the advantages and disadvantages of children using smartphones from an early age. Support your arguments with specific reasons and illustrative examples.

body1.example: For instance, primary students can use English learning apps for 20 minutes a day to practice speaking and receive instant feedback on their mistakes.
body1.focus: Advantages: Educational support and quick communication
body1.frame: Firstly, the first reason is that [ld1]... / Advantages (Body Chunk B)
body1.point: Early smartphone use helps children make the most of new technology to broaden their mind, study languages faster, and stay in touch with parents safely.

body2.example: For example, many young children spend hours playing games or watching violent videos, which harms their eyes and reduces face-to-face time with classmates.
body2.focus: Disadvantages: Health problems, poor focus, and bad habits
body2.point: However, without proper guidance and self-control, children easily copy bad habits from the internet, suffer from eye strain, and lose focus on schoolwork.

hint.conclusion: In conclusion, early smartphone use brings both benefits and risks, so parents should set clear screen rules so children use phones safely for learning rather than wasting time.

intro.ld2: harming children's health, focus, and social skills

Tiêu đề đề bài: Task 1.2: Replying to Alex About the Upcoming Trip to Scotland
Nội dung chi tiết:
You have received an email from your friend, Alex, regarding your upcoming trip to Scotland together. Read part of his email below:

"I am super excited about our upcoming trip to Scotland! First, when would you like to depart? Second, do you agree with traveling there by train, and what transport should we use to get around once we are in Scotland? Also, we will be staying at my uncle's house in the mountains—do you worry there might be a lack of entertainment or interesting places to visit nearby?"

Write an informal email responding to Alex.
title: Task 1.2: Replying to Alex About the Upcoming Trip to Scotland
content:
You have received an email from your friend, Alex, regarding your upcoming trip to Scotland together. Read part of his email below:

"I am super excited about our upcoming trip to Scotland! First, when would you like to depart? Second, do you agree with traveling there by train, and what transport should we use to get around once we arrive in Scotland? Also, we will be staying at my uncle's house in the mountains—do you worry there might be a lack of entertainment or interesting places to visit nearby?"

Write an informal email responding to Alex.

body.answer: I would like to let you know that I prefer leaving on Saturday morning around 8 a.m.
body.example: We can finish packing on Friday night and catch an early train without rushing.
body.reason: This departure time fits comfortably within my daily routine and gives us enough time to arrive before dark.
body.requirement: When you would like to depart

body.answer: From my point of view, I think that traveling there by train is a great idea.
body.example: We can chat, listen to music, or look out the window at the countryside during the ride.
body.reason: Taking the train is fast, convenient for busy people, and allows us to relax comfortably instead of driving a long distance.
body.requirement: Whether you agree with traveling to Scotland by train

body.answer: I believe we should use local buses and trains to move between towns, and walk around small villages.
body.example: We can take a local bus from the station to nearby sights and walk along the scenic trails.
body.reason: Public transport is affordable, helps protect the environment, and lets us stay on the safe side without worrying about driving on narrow mountain roads.
body.requirement: What transport to use to get around once arriving in Scotland

body.answer: I think that staying at your uncle's mountain house will be wonderful, so I am not worried about a lack of entertainment at all.
body.example: We can go hiking in the fresh air during the day, visit nearby villages, and play board games or cook dinner together at night.
body.reason: Being in crowded, noisy public venues easily makes people feel stressed, whereas a mountain house offers a quiet, cozy environment that is beneficial to our physical and mental health.
body.requirement: Whether you worry about a lack of entertainment or places to visit near his uncle's house in the mountains

Tiêu đề đề bài: Task 2.2: Advantages and Disadvantages of Working in Public Places
Nội dung chi tiết:
Read the following statement:

"Nowadays, many people prefer working or studying in public places such as coffee shops, libraries, or coworking spaces instead of working in traditional offices or at home."

Write an essay to an educated reader discussing both the advantages and disadvantages of working in public places. Include specific reasons and examples from your knowledge or experience to support your arguments.
title: Task 2.2: Advantages and Disadvantages of Working in Public Places
content:
Read the following statement:

"Nowadays, many people prefer working or studying in public places such as coffee shops, libraries, or coworking spaces instead of working in traditional offices or at home."

Write an essay to an educated reader discussing both the advantages and disadvantages of working in public places. Include specific reasons and examples from your knowledge or experience to support your arguments.

body1.example: For instance, a freelancer can work in a modern coworking space with fast internet and meet like-minded people to exchange creative ideas.
body1.focus: Advantages: Convenient facilities and social connection
body1.frame: Firstly, the first reason is that [ld1]... / Advantages (Body Chunk B)
body1.point: Public places like cafes and coworking spaces are fast, convenient for busy people, equipped with modern facilities, and help workers avoid feeling lonely at home.

body2.example: For example, loud phone calls at a crowded coffee shop make it hard to focus on important tasks, and buying drinks every day costs a great deal of money.
body2.focus: Disadvantages: Noise, high costs, and lack of privacy
body2.point: However, crowded, noisy public venues easily make people feel stressed, lack personal privacy, and create risks when using public Wi-Fi for private work.

hint.conclusion: In conclusion, working in public places has both pros and cons; it is useful for short tasks and networking, while quiet home or office spaces remain better for deep focus.

intro.ld1: enjoy convenient facilities and social energy
intro.ld2: handling noise, extra costs, and privacy issues
